name: @wm/server
description: WorldMonitor server code: the sebuf gateway, the per-domain RPC handlers (worldmonitor/<domain>/v<N>/) and their shared helpers (_shared/), bundled into the Vercel Edge functions under api/. api/, middleware.ts, apps/web/vite.dev-api.ts, packages/shared and this package import it by relative path, never as @wm/server, until a Vercel preview proves workspace packages in Edge bundles (lint:boundaries Check 5); only the Lite UI (apps/web/src/lite) imports @wm/server/_shared/... by name. A .ts module is imported without its extension; .js, .mjs and .json files name theirs (a .js or .mjs module's types come from its .d.ts or .d.mts sibling). There is deliberately no ./*.ts key: Vite 6 compiles the dot in a pattern key's suffix as a regex wildcard.
